title: Traffic Deaths Fell While Pedestrian Deaths Rose 77%
hook: Traffic deaths fell, but pedestrian deaths rose 77%.
closing: Safer vehicles have not made American streets equally safe for people walking.
question: Do your streets feel safe to walk?

segments.say: US traffic deaths fell to 40,990, continuing an overall decline.
Pedestrian deaths rose 77%, moving opposite the broader traffic trend.
Pedestrians accounted for 7,508 deaths, showing how heavily the remaining danger falls on people walking.
